/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-zh.sv.caption: TCP Connect：完成三向交握
/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-zh.sv.description: 透過 connect() 完成 TCP 連線，然後結束測試。

rows.title: SYN
rows.body: 掃描端 → 目標：提出連線與同步資訊。

rows.title: SYN＋ACK
rows.body: 目標 → 掃描端：接受請求，提供自己的同步資訊。

rows.title: ACK
rows.body: 掃描端 → 目標：完成一般交握。

/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-zh.sv.footer: TCP 連線成功還需另查 TLS、HTTP 與應用功能。

/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-zh.svg.caption: SYN Scan：取得起始回應後重設
/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-zh.svg.description: SYN＋ACK 已提供 open 證據；不送最後 ACK。

rows.title: SYN
rows.body: 掃描端 → 目標：提出連線與同步資訊。

rows.title: SYN＋ACK
rows.body: 目標 → 掃描端：接受請求，提供自己的同步資訊。

rows.title: RST
rows.body: 掃描端 → 目標：重設嘗試；未完成一般交握。

/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-zh.svg.footer: 目標回 RST 才是拒絕；掃描端送 RST 是結束嘗試。

/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-zh.s.caption: UDP：送出資料報，分別判讀四種回應
/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-zh.s.description: 掃描端 → 目標：UDP 資料報。四張卡是替代結果，沒有先後順序。

rows.title: open
rows.body: 收到對應 UDP 回覆；此路徑有端點回應。

rows.title: closed
rows.body: 收到 IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 3：Port Unreachable。

rows.title: filtered
rows.body: 收到 IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 1、2、9、10、13。

rows.title: open|filtered
rows.body: 重試後仍無回覆：可能開放但沉默，也可能受到過濾。

/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-zh.s.footer: 核對 ICMP 來源與原始資料報；IPv4 數字不套用 ICMPv6。

/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-zh..caption: 同一 TCP 443，不同觀察位置
/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-zh..description: 三條獨立路徑示例；實際政策必須查核，並非固定結果。

rows.title: 內網測試端
rows.body: 防火牆／路由政策 → 可能允許

rows.title: 訪客網路
rows.body: 防火牆／路由政策 → 可能限制

rows.title: 外部網路
rows.body: 防火牆／路由政策 → 可能阻擋

/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-zh..footer: 先比對來源、時間、協定、Port、酬載、等待與速率；核對 NAT／代理後是否為同一入口。

/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-en.sv.caption: TCP Connect: complete the handshake
/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-en.sv.description: Use connect() to establish TCP, then end the test.

rows.title: SYN
rows.body: Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.

rows.title: SYN+ACK
rows.body: Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization information.

rows.title: ACK
rows.body: Scanner → target: complete the ordinary handshake.

/images/ceh/m03-03-01-connect-flow-en.sv.footer: TCP success still requires separate TLS, HTTP and application checks.

/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-en.svg.caption: SYN Scan: reset after the opening response
/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-en.svg.description: SYN+ACK supplies open evidence; no final ACK is sent.

rows.title: SYN
rows.body: Scanner → target: request a connection and synchronize.

rows.title: SYN+ACK
rows.body: Target → scanner: accept and supply synchronization information.

rows.title: RST
rows.body: Scanner → target: reset; the ordinary handshake is incomplete.

/images/ceh/m03-03-02-syn-flow-en.svg.footer: A target RST refuses; a scanner-side RST ends this attempt.

/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-en.s.caption: UDP: send a datagram, interpret four outcomes
/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-en.s.description: Scanner → target: UDP datagram. Cards are alternative outcomes, not a sequence.

rows.title: open
rows.body: A corresponding UDP reply: an endpoint responded on this path.

rows.title: closed
rows.body: IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 3: Port Unreachable.

rows.title: filtered
rows.body: IPv4 ICMP Type 3 / Code 1, 2, 9, 10 or 13.

rows.title: open|filtered
rows.body: No reply after retries: possibly open and silent, or filtered.

/images/ceh/m03-03-03-udp-responses-en.s.footer: Match ICMP to its source and original datagram; IPv4 codes do not apply to ICMPv6.

/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-en..caption: The same TCP 443 from different positions
/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-en..description: Three independent example paths; verify actual policy rather than assuming these outcomes.

rows.title: Internal test host
rows.body: Firewall / routing policy → may allow

rows.title: Guest network
rows.body: Firewall / routing policy → may restrict

rows.title: External network
rows.body: Firewall / routing policy → may block

/images/ceh/m03-03-05-scan-positions-en..footer: Compare source, time, protocol, port, payload, timeout and rate; confirm the same endpoint behind NAT or proxies.
